positions.name: DeriveIdE2ETestSpec
positions.frame: what does the missing-id derive-id E2E test need to reproduce and guarantee?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the same E2E test artifact from two angles: src-1 asserts what the test reproduces (the prod missing-id failure pattern, a heading without an id field), and src-2 states the behavioral requirement the reproduction must satisfy (no crash, valid slug). The directional reads align — calm, technical/matter-of-fact register, competence-value — describing a single test case's design contract rather than two unrelated claims. Read together they specify the test's coverage: the failure it must reproduce and the guarantee it must uphold when doing so.
